df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
sub = df[df['account_id']=='sBGaYvw'].copy()
keys=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']

# For each resource, z-score of 10-20 cost vs its own history (excluding 10-20)
day='2025-10-20'
g = sub.pivot_table(index=keys, columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum')
res=[]
for idx in g.index:
    s = g.loc[idx].drop(day)
    m, sd = s.mean(), s.std()
    if sd>0:
        z = (g.loc[idx, day]-m)/sd
    else:
        z = 0.0 if abs(g.loc[idx,day]-m)<1e-9 else np.inf
    res.append((idx, z, g.loc[idx,day]-m))
resdf = pd.DataFrame(res, columns=['key','z','diff']).sort_values('z', ascending=False)
